# Name: # above the current ~2MB app image (mruby brings Host role over the
# previous default 1MB factory partition) with headroom for growth.
# mrb_script: raw (non-filesystem) storage for one uploaded mruby script -
# a 4-byte little-endian length header followed by the script's UTF-8
# over serial without rebuilding/reflashing the app image. Read at boot by
# main/mruby_filter.c; falls back to the embedded main/mruby_scripts/default.rb
# if this partition is empty/erased/invalid. Custom subtype 0x50 is in
# gen_esp32part.py places it right after factory.
